newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Several Russian soldiers die in warhead blast.
newsitem.headline: Several Russian soldiers die in warhead blast.

text.p: Several soldiers were killed when the warhead of a missile exploded at a military base in Komsomolsk-on-Amur in Russia's far east, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.
The agency quoted military sources as saying the warhead had exploded on Sunday outside working hours when security was minimal, suggesting they had been trying to remove it.

It quoted General Oleg Kuznetsov, commander of the base about 250 km (310 miles) from Russia's Pacific coast, as saying several soldiers had been killed in a powerful blast but did not say what had caused it.
